overview.oneLine: An open-source e-commerce skateboard shop built with Next.js 13, Drizzle ORM, Planetscale, Stripe, and Tailwind CSS.

stack.text: Next.js 13 (App Router) for the full-stack React framework
Drizzle ORM with PlanetScale (MySQL) as the database layer

entryPoints.text: src/app/layout.tsx — root Next.js layout, providers and metadata

keyFacts.text: Authentication is handled by Clerk (not NextAuth), with middleware protecting /dashboard routes
Database schema lives in src/db/schema.ts using Drizzle's table definitions
Sellers can create stores and list products; buyers can add to cart and checkout via Stripe
Server Actions are used for mutations (Next.js 13.4+ feature), no separate tRPC/API layer
Email notifications sent via Resend using React Email templates

layers.name: UI / Pages
layers.summary: Next.js App Router pages and client components. Handles routing, layouts, and all user-facing rendering. RSC is used for data fetching; Client Components for interactivity.

layers.name: Server Actions
layers.summary: Next.js 13.4 Server Actions replace a traditional API layer. All write mutations (create store, add product, checkout) flow through these functions, keeping business logic server-side.

layers.name: Auth (Clerk)
layers.summary: Clerk handles sign-up, sign-in, and session management. Middleware enforces authentication on all /dashboard/** routes. User identity is propagated via auth() helper.

layers.name: Data Layer (Drizzle + PlanetScale)
layers.summary: Drizzle ORM over a PlanetScale (MySQL) serverless connection. Schema is defined as TypeScript objects. Migrations are managed via drizzle-kit.

layers.name: Payments (Stripe)
layers.summary: Stripe Checkout is used for multi-vendor cart payments. A webhook handler at /api/webhooks/stripe processes payment events and fulfils orders.

layers.name: File Uploads (Uploadthing)
layers.summary: Uploadthing provides a type-safe file upload API. Product images are uploaded here and the returned URLs stored in PlanetScale via Drizzle.

candidates.title: Add server-side price validation to product creation
candidates.externalDependencyRisk: None — pure server-side logic, no external calls.
candidates.reason: Self-contained change in a single Server Action. Low blast radius, clear acceptance criterion, and validates an important invariant.

candidates.title: Migrate authentication from Clerk to NextAuth
candidates.externalDependencyRisk: Requires NextAuth setup and Clerk teardown; breaks all sessions during migration.
candidates.reason: High blast radius touching auth middleware and all protected routes. Not suitable as a first task for a new team member.

candidates.title: Add required alt-text field to product images
candidates.externalDependencyRisk: Requires a schema migration on PlanetScale.
candidates.reason: Touches the database schema and requires a live migration, adding unnecessary risk for a first task.
